parsed.explanation: The division adds a tier-1 universal exposure on top of an already restrictive parent regime: a birth-sex facility rule (2024, extended to campuses in 2026) with no documented working remedy, plus its freeze-frame prison-treatment policy and no state hate-crime statute. The parent supplies traveler-facing exposure too: entry officers instructed to refuse cases where sex is in doubt, passport-marker blocking, and eight foreign governments issuing trans travel advisories — state-directed discovery risk. Mitigating: no trans-specific criminal offence, functioning courts that have enjoined several national measures and blocked enforcement against one student, national hate-crime protection, and no documented pattern of violence targeting visitors. This is neither severe (no imprisonment for identity, no organised targeting) nor reduced risk (unremedied universal facility exclusion plus border friction).
